notes.title: v1.0.3 Address Steam reviews comments
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Make some measures to prevent drops from quantum tunneling through the jar's glass
[*] Make the jar's glass thinner, so it will hopefully be easier to see drops in the jar
[*] Drop on the mouse button up to make it easier for touch-screen players
[*] Add double-papa cake achievement; good luck with getting it on hard difficulty (evil laugh)
[*] Fix the instant fail on some angles
[*] Remove the ugly scrollbar from the right leaderboard
[*] Prevent drops from combining with drops in the hand
[*] Make the background of achievement icons gray
[/list]
